text: なかから　おとが　きこえてくる　もうすぐ　うまれそうだ！

structure.jp: おとが　きこえてくる
もうすぐ　うまれそうだ！
structure.en: it looks about to hatch soon!

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says something comes toward you. きこえてくる = 'can be heard coming this way'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (appearance)
patterns.explanation: そうだ stuck onto the short stem of a verb means 'looks like it is about to'. うまれそうだ = 'looks like it's about to hatch'.
